name: Block Garden - Knowledge Hub
description: 3D sandbox exploration, procedural world generation, farming, and interactive game engine documentation powered by ShadowClaw.

skills.name: fireworks
skills.description: Launches real-time 3D voxel fireworks particle physics displays in the sky using Block Garden's API.

skills.name: konami-code
skills.description: Executes the secret Konami Code sequence (↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A) to unlock dev mode, ore depth locator, fast growth, and hidden menu items.

skills.name: link
skills.description: Places an interactive 3D voxel link in the world that opens any destination URL when broken/mined by the player.

skills.name: messaging
skills.description: Draws custom 3D voxel text messages in the sky of the live Block Garden world.

skills.name: photo
skills.description: Quantizes and renders any photo, image URL, or base64 data URI into 3D voxel pixel mosaic art in Block Garden.

skills.name: scan-for-nearby-ores
skills.description: Scans loaded Block Garden voxel chunks for nearby ore deposits around player coordinates.

skills.name: tic-tac-toe
skills.description: Creates an interactive, playable 3D voxel Tic-Tac-Toe minigame in Block Garden with player switching, win detection, and reset button.

skills.name: video
skills.description: Creates an in-world real-time camera video display screen in Block Garden, streaming webcam frames directly into 3D voxels.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, edit, review, and validate ShadowClaw declarative skills and their supporting resources.
